name: 🥖 Philly Cheesesteaks
what: Thin-shaved steak and soft onions with melted cheese, flipped into toasted rolls.
early: Ribeye into the freezer 30–40 minutes before you slice it.

core.name: Ribeye steak
core.out: sirloin, or deli roast beef warmed in the pan

extras: bell pepper, butter, ketchup, hot peppers

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Slice the half-frozen steak as thin as you can.
Cook the onions in butter over medium until soft and sweet. Set aside.
Toast the split rolls cut side down in the pan.
High heat, a little oil, steak in one layer with salt and pepper. Sear 1 minute, then chop and toss.
Onions back in, 4 piles, cheese on top. Roll over each pile, slide the spatula under, flip.

key: Half-freeze the steak first. It's the only way to slice it paper-thin.
done: No red left on the steak and the cheese is melted.
plan_b: Out of steak? Ground beef cheesesteaks, same onions and cheese.
